headline: NASA hopes the commercial space industry can help save Hubble
summary: Hubble telescope faces demise in the 2030s without an orbit boost. NASA seeks commercial space industry proposals to extend Hubble's mission. Gravity is slowly dragging the famed telescope closer to Earth.

headline: Flock keeps ignoring requests to cancel its contracts
summary: Cities are struggling to cancel contracts with Flock Safety. Plymouth, Minnesota, voted to terminate its contract but Flock ignored the request. Surveillance cameras remained active for over a month despite the city's efforts.

headline: Apple's HomeView could add security camera features
summary: Hidden code in HomeView 27.2 suggests new security camera features for Apple's smart home hub. Features include motion detection, live streaming, recording, and privacy functions. A setup page explicitly mentions a security camera mode.

headline: A fully playable version of Portal prequel F-Stop leaked
summary: Leakers have assembled a playable version of the canceled Portal prequel, F-Stop. Assets were sourced from a massive 12-terabyte leak in August. The game's source code and map data were recently found on Discord.

headline: Clayface Comes in Second to You Can See Everything at the Domestic Box Office on Halloween Weekend
summary: Clayface finished second at the domestic box office over Halloween weekend. Audiences flocked to the Elizabeth Holmes documentary, "You Can See Everything." This shows strong continued interest in the documentary.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Gears of War: E-Day, Apple Watch Ultra 4, Star Wars Zero Company, and More
summary: This article highlights today's top deals and discounts. Featured items include Gears of War: E-Day and Apple Watch Ultra 4. Star Wars Zero Company and other products are also on sale.

headline: Heat Director Michael Mann Hospitalized After Accidentally Shooting Himself in the Leg
summary: Director Michael Mann was hospitalized with minor injuries. He accidentally shot himself in the leg. The incident occurred at a Los Angeles gun range on Halloween.

headline: Taika Waititi Blasts Critics as 'Irrelevant, Out of Touch, Obsolete' Following Klara and the Sun's Negative Reviews
summary: Filmmaker Taika Waititi slammed critics following negative reviews for "Klara and the Sun." He called critics "sad lost souls who couldn't achieve their dreams." Waititi's comments come after his latest film premiered to poor reception.

headline: Ukraine air raid app apparently hacked as users receive false radiation threat, Air Force says
summary: Ukraine's air raid alert app was reportedly hacked. Users received false radiation threat warnings. Authorities advised calm, urging reliance on official information channels.

headline: Five teenagers stabbed at Halloween party
summary: Five teenagers were stabbed at a Halloween party in Chandler's Ford. Hampshire Police believe an unknown group gained unauthorized entry. The incident is under investigation.

headline: 'Like a missile coming down' - Nine killed in fiery Florida jet crash
summary: Nine people died in a fiery jet crash in Florida. The crash happened near President Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy called it a "horrific tragedy."

headline: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut
summary: Virgin Media O2 is set to cut thousands of jobs. The broadband provider has not finalized the exact number of roles. The BBC understands it will be a significant portion of its workforce.
